messages.subject: Cadence implementation – SOW timeline
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Reviewing the Statement of Work. The 5 Jan go-live is tight given our SAP integration. Can your team confirm the ERP connector work (Phase 2) can finish by 21 Nov? We'll free up our systems team and provide API credentials by 17 Oct mobilisation.

Priya Nandakumar | Head of Supply Chain Systems | Harcourt

messages.subject: RE: Cadence implementation – SOW timeline
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

Yes – Phase 2 (SAP + telematics connectors) completes 21 Nov per the SOW, provided we get credentials at mobilisation. Data migration of 24 months' movement data wraps 5 Dec, UAT 19 Dec, go-live 5 Jan. The fixed £120k implementation fee covers all of this; any out-of-scope changes we'll quote at £1,100/day first.

Daniel Okorie | COO | Meridian
